integrity: The fixed-order cheap-rim law is proved analytically; the opposite order uses the cited fixed-price limit. Sample calculations are corroboration, not a limit proof.
scientific_limitations: Simple undirected wheels, constant linear price within each edge class, the sum of electrical pair resistances, and the two specified iterated limits only. The priced-wheel spectral objective and fixed-price allocation law are credited as existing results.
title: Noncommuting cheap-rim and large-wheel limits in resistance-optimal design
